rules.title: Prohibition of Unqualified Banking Verbs
rules.suggested_replacement: Partner with Acme Financial Technologies, an FDIC-insured banking partner.

source_citation.exact_quote: Marketing collateral must never instruct consumers to "bank on us" or imply Acme itself holds banking charters.
All collateral must use the formal nomenclature: "Digital asset custody solutions".

rules.title: Strict Ban on Performance Guarantees
rules.suggested_replacement: Historical projected APY; yields subject to market volatility.

source_citation.exact_quote: Copywriters must never use the phrase "guaranteed returns", "risk-free yield", or "guaranteed APY".

rules.title: Loan Approval Speed Disclosures
rules.suggested_replacement: Pre-qualified digital underwriting in as little as 3 minutes.

source_citation.exact_quote: The phrase "instant loan" or "instant approval" is deceptive and forbidden.
The brand name must strictly appear in Title Case as "Acme".

rules.title: Fee-Free Claims Qualification
rules.suggested_replacement: No monthly maintenance fees; other transactional charges may apply.

source_citation.exact_quote: Marketing text must never state "zero fees" without qualification.

rules.title: Educational Case Studies & Partner Portal Disclosures

source_citation.exact_quote: All educational case studies and technical thought leadership articles must display full state statutory disclosures prominently, except when published exclusively within verified enterprise partner portals.
Any marketing statement quoting system uptime, such as "99.99% uptime", must reference an active substantiated benchmark in the approved claims registry.
Marketing text citing active customer scale (e.g., "Over 2 million active accounts") is verified through December 31, 2026.

rules.title: Urgent Pressure Tactics & Fear of Missing Out (FOMO)
rules.forbidden_term: act now or miss out forever
rules.suggested_replacement: Explore our portfolio solutions at your convenience.

source_citation.exact_quote: High-pressure sales phrases such as "Act now or miss out forever!" or "Don't get left behind!" are strictly prohibited in public communications.

rules.title: Ban on Slang & Financial Colloquialisms
rules.suggested_replacement: Competitive interest rates on digital treasury solutions.

source_citation.exact_quote: The use of internet slang, hype terminology ("super dope yields", "moon shot", "HODL"), or excessive exclamation marks is prohibited across all corporate releases and landing pages.

rules.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) Contrast Standards

source_citation.exact_quote: All promotional text rendered across web and mobile surfaces must maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against the underlying background surface to ensure legibility and compliance.
